# Match Text

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Matches text in the input based on regex.

## Syntax

~~~~text
matchText(text: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, regex: <#String (Allows Variables)#>, caseSensitive: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
matchText(text: "Hello World!", regex: "", caseSensitive: )
~~~~
